name: Beef tacos
steps: Put the ground beef and onion in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook 8–10 minutes, breaking up the meat, until no pink remains and it reaches 160°F.
Spoon off most of the fat, then stir in the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, a big pinch of salt and 1/3 cup water; simmer 3 minutes until saucy.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan over medium heat for about 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with beef, then top with cheese, lettuce and salsa.

name: Chicken quesadilla
steps: Toss the chicken with the chili powder and a pinch of salt.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 6–8 minutes, stirring, until no longer pink inside and it reaches 165°F; move to a plate and wipe out the pan.
Lay a tortilla in the pan over medium heat, sprinkle cheese over half, add half the chicken, then a little more cheese and fold it over.
Cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts; repeat with the second tortilla.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream if you like.

name: Bean and cheese burrito
steps: Put the black beans in a small pot with the cumin, garlic powder, a pinch of salt and 3 tbsp water.
Cook over medium heat 5 minutes, mashing about half the beans with a fork, until thick and hot.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or the microwave for 20 seconds so they bend without cracking.
Spread the beans down the middle of each tortilla, top with cheese and salsa, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Optional: toast the burritos seam-side down in a pan over medium heat for 2 minutes per side until golden.

name: Chicken burrito bowl
steps: Rub the chicken all over with the chili powder, cumin and 1/2 tsp salt.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 5–7 minutes per side until it reaches 165°F in the thickest part; rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Meanwhile warm the black beans and corn together in a small pot over medium heat for 4–5 minutes.
Heat the rice in the microwave for 2 minutes and squeeze in half the lime.
Divide the rice between bowls and top with beans, corn, sliced chicken and salsa; serve with the remaining lime cut into wedges.

name: Black bean soup

ingredients.note: use vegetable broth to keep it vegetarian

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and cumin and stir 1 minute.
Add the black beans, broth and salsa, bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer 15 minutes.
Mash about half the beans with a potato masher (or blend half the soup) to thicken it.
Squeeze in the lime juice, season with salt, and serve topped with a spoonful of sour cream if you like.

name: Turkey chili
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and cook the onion and bell pepper 5 minutes until softened.
Add the ground turkey and cook 6–8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 165°F.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin and 1 tsp salt and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, black beans and 1/2 cup water, bring to a boil, then cover partly and simmer on low for 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
Taste, add more salt if needed, and serve with cheese or sour cream if you have them.

name: Chicken fajitas
steps: Toss the chicken with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and 1 tbsp oil.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 6–8 minutes, stirring, until it reaches 165°F; move to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, then the bell pepper and onion; cook 5–6 minutes until soft and a little charred at the edges.
Return the chicken to the pan, squeeze over the lime juice and toss.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave and fill with the chicken and vegetables.

name: Shrimp tacos

ingredients.note: peeled and deveined, thawed if frozen

steps: Toss the cabbage with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt; set aside.
Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the chili powder, garlic powder and 1/2 tsp salt.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp 1–2 minutes per side until pink and opaque all the way through.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, then fill with cabbage and shrimp, add a spoonful of sour cream, sprinkle with cilantro and serve with the second lime in wedges.

name: Fish tacos
steps: Stir the mayo with the juice of 1 lime and a few dashes of hot sauce to make a quick sauce.
Pat the fish dry and season both sides with the chili powder, cumin and 1/2 tsp salt.
Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and cook the fish 3–4 minutes per side until opaque and it flakes easily with a fork; break into chunks.
Warm the tortillas, then fill with cabbage and fish, drizzle with the sauce and serve with the second lime in wedges.

name: Cheese enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Stir the crushed tomatoes, salsa, chili powder, cumin and 1/2 tsp salt together in a bowl to make the sauce.
Spread 1/2 cup of the sauce over the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave for 30 seconds so they bend, then fill each with a small handful of cheese and some onion, roll up and lay seam-side down in the dish.
Pour the remaining sauce over the top and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling and the cheese is melted; rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Chicken tortilla soup
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion 5 minutes until soft; add the garlic, chili powder and cumin and stir 1 minute.
Add the broth, tomatoes and whole chicken breasts, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low 15–20 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F.
While it simmers, toss the tortilla strips with the remaining oil and a pinch of salt and bake at 400°F for 8–10 minutes until crisp.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and return it to the pot with the corn; simmer 5 minutes more.
Squeeze in the lime juice, season with salt, and serve topped with the crispy tortilla strips.

name: Mexican rice

ingredients.note: use vegetable broth to keep it vegetarian

steps: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat, add the rice and stir 4–5 minutes until lightly golden.
Add the onion and garlic and cook 2 minutes, then stir in the tomato paste and cumin until the rice is coated.
Pour in the broth and 1/2 tsp salt, bring to a boil, then cover tightly and cook on low for 18 minutes without lifting the lid.
Take off the heat, leave covered 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

name: Loaded nachos
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Toss the tortilla wedges with the oil and a pinch of salt, spread on a baking sheet and bake 8–10 minutes until crisp (or use a bag of tortilla chips and skip this).
Pile the chips close together on the sheet and scatter over the black beans, cheese and jalapeno.
Bake 5–7 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Top with the tomatoes, dollops of sour cream and salsa and eat right away.

name: Taco salad

ingredients.note: corn, or a few handfuls of tortilla chips

steps: Cook the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat 8–10 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 160°F; drain off the fat.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 cup water and simmer 2 minutes.
Cut the tortillas into strips and toast them in a dry pan over medium heat for 4–5 minutes, turning, until crisp.
Stir the salsa and sour cream together to make a dressing.
Pile the lettuce into bowls, top with the beef, tomatoes, cheese and tortilla strips, and drizzle with the dressing.

name: Black bean and corn quesadilla
steps: Mix the black beans, corn, cumin and a pinch of salt in a bowl, lightly mashing a few beans so the filling holds together.
Melt half the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and lay in a tortilla.
Sprinkle cheese over half the tortilla, spoon on half the bean mixture, add a little more cheese and fold over.
Cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts; repeat with the remaining butter and tortilla.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa if you like.

name: Sweet potato black bean tacos

ingredients.note: medium, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes with the oil, chili powder, cumin and 1/2 tsp salt and spread on a baking sheet.
Roast 25 minutes, turning once halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
Warm the black beans in a small pot over medium heat for 4–5 minutes with a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas, then fill with sweet potato, beans and avocado, and squeeze lime juice over the top.

name: Salsa chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Season the chicken on both sides with the chili powder, cumin and 1/2 tsp salt and lay it in a baking dish.
Pour the salsa over the chicken so it is covered.
Bake 20–25 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F in the thickest part.
Sprinkle with the cheese and bake 3–5 minutes more until melted; serve over rice if you like.

name: Street corn salad
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the corn in an even layer and cook 6–8 minutes, stirring only every couple of minutes, until charred in spots.
Let the corn cool for 5 minutes.
In a bowl stir together the mayo, juice of the lime, chili powder and a pinch of salt.
Add the corn, feta, red onion and cilantro and toss well; serve warm or cold.

name: Guacamole
steps: Halve the avocados, remove the pits and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Squeeze in the lime juice, add 1/2 tsp salt and mash with a fork until mostly smooth but still a little chunky.
Stir in the red onion, plus the tomatoes, jalapeno and cilantro if using.
Taste and add more salt or lime; serve right away with chips (press plastic wrap on the surface if storing).

name: Pico de gallo

ingredients.note: a small handful of cilantro, chopped

steps: Put the diced tomatoes, onion and jalapeno in a bowl.
Add the cilantro, the juice of the lime and 1/2 tsp salt and stir well.
Let it sit 10 minutes so the flavors blend, then taste and add more salt or lime; serve with chips, tacos or eggs.

name: Black bean tostadas
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Brush the tortillas lightly with oil on both sides, lay them on a baking sheet and bake 8–10 minutes, flipping once, until crisp and golden.
Meanwhile warm the black beans with the cumin, a pinch of salt and 2 tbsp water in a small pot over medium heat, mashing them with a fork into a rough paste, about 5 minutes.
Spread the beans over each crisp tortilla and top with lettuce, cheese, salsa and a little sour cream if you like.

name: Steak tacos
steps: Pat the steak dry and rub with the chili powder, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and the juice of 1 lime.
Heat the oil in a heavy skillet over high heat until shimmering and sear the steak 4–5 minutes per side until well browned and it reaches 135°F for medium (145°F for well done).
Rest the steak 5 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain and chop into small pieces.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, fill with steak, and top with onion, cilantro and a squeeze of the second lime.

name: Chilaquiles
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the tortilla wedges in batches 2–3 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp; drain on paper towels and sprinkle with salt.
Pour off all but a thin film of oil, add the eggs and fry over medium heat 3–4 minutes until the whites are set; move to a plate.
Pour the salsa and 1/4 cup water into the pan, simmer 1 minute, then add the chips and toss for 30 seconds so they are coated but still a little crunchy.
Top with the cheese, fried eggs, sour cream and onion and serve immediately.

name: Migas
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and fry the tortilla strips 3–4 minutes, stirring, until golden and crisp.
Add the onion and jalapeno and cook 2 minutes, then add the tomatoes and cook 1 minute more.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently 2–3 minutes until just set; sprinkle with the cheese, cover for 30 seconds to melt, and serve with salsa if you like.
